title: 线程的创建、join 与确定性顺序基线
expected_output:
T1 sum = 499500
T2 sum = 1499500
T3 sum = 2499500
线程数 = 0
主线程仍在: True
join 后子线程全部结束: True
code:
import threading

# 结论先行：并发不等于乱序 —— 没有同步原语时，输出顺序本身就不可依赖。
# 本示例用 join 建立确定性顺序，作为后续「竞态演示」的对照基线。

results = []
lock = threading.Lock()


def work(name, begin, end):
    total = sum(range(begin, end))
    with lock:
        results.append((name, total))


threads = [
    threading.Thread(target=work, args=("T1", 0, 1000)),
    threading.Thread(target=work, args=("T2", 1000, 2000)),
    threading.Thread(target=work, args=("T3", 2000, 3000)),
]

for t in threads:
    t.start()
for t in threads:
    t.join()   # join 才能保证「线程已结束」，否则主线程可能先打印

# 按名字排序输出，消除「谁先抢到 lock」带来的顺序不确定
for name, total in sorted(results):
    print("%s sum = %d" % (name, total))

print("线程数 =", threading.active_count() - 1)
print("主线程仍在:", threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread())
print("join 后子线程全部结束:", all(not t.is_alive() for t in threads))
